== Trivia ==
*The '''Soul Campfire Initiates'''<nowiki>'</nowiki>s name matches up with the {{Item|Soul Campfire Initiate Badge}}, suggesting that they have earned that badge.
**It also suggests that they have been part of {{NPCSprite|Brian}}'s Campfire Cult for less time than the {{NPCSprite|Soul Campfire Adept}}.
*The '''Campfire Initiates''' are part of {{NPCSprite|Brian}}'s Campfire Cult, along with the {{NPCSprite|Soul Campfire Adept}}.
